blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Northern Samar posted the highest economic growth rate in Eastern Visayas in 2025, with its economy expanding by 4.6% from 3.4% in the previous year, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) regional office. The PSA- 8 released the latest Provincial Product Accounts (PPA) on Oct. 15, showing Northern Samar outperforming the region’s other provinces and Tacloban City, its regional and economic center. Eastern Samar ranked second with 3.9% growth, followed by Biliran at 3.5%, Southern Leyte at 3.3%, and Tacloban City at 3.2%. Samar’s economy grew by 1.4%, while Leyte recorded a 1.2% contraction.
